# Acceptance fixtures

`l0-money-stock.json` contains manually calculated decimal-string expectations covering tax, discount, split tender/change, fractional quantity/rounding, partial refunds, discount residue, weighted-average value and transfers.

These are proposed examples, not a calculation engine or approved tax rules. Test later domain functions against the approved revision. Change expectations only with a documented business-rule change and reviewer reference in the L0 evidence register.
